verdict.rationale: Highnote documents a public GraphQL API with an interactive code explorer, a single key and endpoint, and a production-like test environment. Its guides show the API driving the core workflows: issuing financial accounts and virtual cards, spend rules, velocity controls, notification mutations, and the full authorize/capture/refund lifecycle. A typed Node.js SDK and an llms.txt add AI-friendly access; the OpenAPI 404s are expected for a GraphQL API rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, and evidence of a published machine-readable schema (the Node SDK is still beta).
